title: System surfaces: notification, tile, shortcuts, boot, Tasker

controls.label: Shadowsocks
controls.visible_when: the service is starting or running (notification id 1 is posted from startForeground)
controls.action: shows the profile name as the content title, the rates as the content text, the totals as the subtext, the ticker text and the Stop action; the stateChanged callback is empty; tapping the body opens MainActivity

controls.label: Status bar icon
controls.visible_when: the notification is posted
controls.action: shows drawable ic_service_active in the status bar

controls.label: <profile name>
controls.visible_when: the notification is posted; the text is empty when the start failed before a profile was chosen
controls.action: shows the content title, which is the running profile's formatted name

controls.label: 12 KB/s↑	34 KB/s↓
controls.visible_when: a traffic sample arrived while the service is Connected and the traffic callback is registered
controls.action: shows the current upload and download rates in the traffic template

controls.label: 1.2 MB↑	3.4 MB↓
controls.visible_when: a traffic sample arrived while the service is Connected and the traffic callback is registered
controls.action: shows the session upload and download totals as the notification subtext

controls.label: Stop
controls.visible_when: API < 24 shows a button; API >= 24 adds the same action as an invisible action
controls.action: sends the app-scoped Action.CLOSE broadcast; the service runs stopRunner

controls.label: Notification body
controls.visible_when: the notification is posted
controls.action: fires the content intent: opens MainActivity with FLAG_ACTIVITY_REORDER_TO_FRONT

controls.label: Shadowsocks started.
controls.visible_when: the notification is first posted and the system shows a ticker
controls.action: shows the ticker text forward_success

controls.label: Toggle
controls.visible_when: the user added the tile to Quick Settings
controls.action: a tap stops or starts the service; a long press launches MainActivity through the QS_TILE_PREFERENCES filter, which shows the main screen because MainActivity has no tile-preference handling

controls.label: Tile icon
controls.visible_when: always while the tile is shown
controls.action: shows ic_service_busy while Connecting or Stopping, ic_service_active while Connected, ic_service_idle while Stopped

controls.label: <profile name> or Shadowsocks
controls.visible_when: always while the tile is shown; the profile name only while Connected and the device is unlocked
controls.action: shows the tile label; it falls back to the app name Shadowsocks

controls.label: Toggle
controls.visible_when: the launcher shows the app's static shortcuts (long press the app icon)
controls.action: starts QuickToggleShortcut in the :bg process; it toggles the service and finishes

controls.label: Scan QR code
controls.visible_when: the launcher shows the app's static shortcuts (long press the app icon)
controls.action: opens ScannerActivity

controls.label: Shadowsocks
controls.visible_when: Tasker or Locale sends EDIT_SETTING to ConfigActivity
controls.action: edits one Tasker action: the service switch and the profile

controls.label: Shadowsocks
controls.visible_when: always
controls.action: shows the toolbar title app_name in the toolbar's own TextView, which has no id of its own

controls.label: Close (X icon)
controls.visible_when: always
controls.action: icon-only navigation button with drawable ic_navigation_close and no content description; it has no id of its own; finishes the activity without a result, so Tasker keeps the previous setting

controls.label: Start the service
controls.visible_when: always
controls.action: sets the switch state that a row tap stores as switch_on; the switch alone does not save

controls.label: Profile list
controls.visible_when: always
controls.action: lists the default row and one row per active profile; scrolls to the saved profile; the layout gives the list no label

controls.label: Use the current profile
controls.visible_when: always, as the first row
controls.action: checked when profile_id < 0; a tap stores switch_on and profile_id -1, returns RESULT_OK and finishes

controls.label: <profile name>
controls.visible_when: one row per active profile
controls.action: checked when profile_id equals the profile id; a tap stores switch_on and that id, returns RESULT_OK and finishes

controls.label: Connect to <profile name>
controls.visible_when: the configured action is shown in the Tasker or Locale action list
controls.action: shows the blurb built by Settings.toIntent: Connect to name, Switch to name, Connect to the current server or Stop

rules.statement: The notification content title is the running profile's formatted name.

examples.given: the service stops before a profile is resolved
examples.then: the title is empty

rules.statement: The notification uses ticker Shadowsocks started., icon ic_service_active, category service and no timestamp.

examples.when: a traffic sample rewrites the content text and subtext

rules.statement: Each traffic sample sets the content text to the rates and the subtext to the totals.

examples.given: the sample reports totals 1.2 MB and 3.4 MB
examples.then: the subtext reads 1.2 MB↑	3.4 MB↓

rules.statement: The notification registers the traffic callback when the screen is interactive at creation or on a screen-on while Connected, and unregisters it on a screen-off while Connected.

examples.given: the service is Connected and the screen is on
examples.then: the notification updates every 1000 ms

examples.given: the service is Connected and the screen turns off
examples.then: the callback is unregistered and the text freezes

rules.statement: Screen on and off events change the callback only while the service is Connected.

examples.given: the service is Connected and the screen turns on
examples.then: updateCallback(true) registers the traffic callback and starts bandwidth listening at 1000 ms

examples.given: the service is Stopping and the screen turns on
examples.then: the callback is not re-registered

rules.statement: A traffic sample whose profile id is not zero does not update the notification.

examples.given: a per-profile sample with profile id 7 arrives
examples.then: the notification is not rewritten

examples.given: the summed sample with profile id 0 arrives
examples.then: the notification is rewritten and shown

The service start fails: the notification is created with an empty profile name and destroyed at once, and the failure message reaches the UI through stateChanged, where MainActivity shows it in a snackbar.

cases.title: The ongoing notification appears when the service starts
preconditions: The service mode is VPN (the default).
A valid profile named Tokyo is selected.
Notifications are enabled for the app.
steps: Start the service from the main screen.
Open the notification shade.
expected: A notification is posted as the foreground notification; its content title is the formatted profile name Tokyo.
The notification shows the Shadowsocks icon and the Stop action (invisible on API 24+).

cases.title: The notification traffic line updates while the screen is on
preconditions: The VPN service is Connected with the Tokyo profile.
The screen is on.
steps: Watch the notification for a few seconds.
Send traffic through the tunnel.
expected: The content text shows the current rates as 12 KB/s↑ 34 KB/s↓.
The subtext shows the session totals as 1.2 MB↑ 3.4 MB↓.

cases.title: Traffic updates stop while the screen is off and resume on
preconditions: The VPN service is Connected and the notification shows live traffic.
steps: Turn the screen off and send traffic.
Turn the screen on while connected.
expected: The traffic line does not change while the screen is off.
The traffic line resumes updating after the screen turns on.

cases.title: Stop from the notification stops the service and removes it
preconditions: The VPN service is Connected.
The notification is posted.
The device runs API 23, so the Stop action is a visible notification button.
steps: Activate the visible Stop action in the notification.
Open the notification shade again.
expected: The service enters Stopping and then Stopped.
The notification is gone and the foreground state is cleared.

cases.title: Tapping the notification body opens the app
preconditions: The VPN service is Connected.
The app is in the background.
steps: Tap the notification body.
expected: MainActivity comes to the front with the profile list.

cases.title: A start without a profile posts an empty notification then stops
preconditions: No profile is selected or the selected profile is invalid.
steps: Start the service.
Read the resulting state and notification.
expected: A notification with an empty title is posted briefly.
The service stops with the profile error: Please select a profile when no profile exists, otherwise the invalid-config message; the notification is removed.

cases.title: The tile label shows the profile name only while the device is unlocked
preconditions: The Toggle tile is added to Quick Settings.
The service is Connected with Tokyo.
steps: Open Quick Settings while the device is unlocked.
Lock the device and refresh the tile.
expected: The tile shows the active icon, STATE_ACTIVE and the label Tokyo.
The tile label changes to Shadowsocks while the keyguard is locked.

cases.title: A tile tap while connecting cancels the connection and stops
preconditions: The service is Connecting with a valid profile.
steps: Tap the tile.
Observe the tile until the service stops.
expected: Core.stopService sends Action.CLOSE and the connecting job is cancelled.
The tile shows the busy icon and STATE_UNAVAILABLE, then the idle icon and STATE_INACTIVE.

cases.title: A tile tap while connected stops the service
preconditions: The service is Connected.
steps: Tap the tile.
Observe the tile until the service stops.
expected: Core.stopService sends Action.CLOSE.
The tile shows the busy icon and STATE_UNAVAILABLE, then the idle icon and STATE_INACTIVE.

cases.title: A tile tap while stopped starts the service
preconditions: The service is Stopped and a valid profile is selected.
steps: Tap the tile.
Observe the tile after the tunnel connects.
expected: Core.startService starts the foreground service.
The tile shows the busy icon and STATE_ACTIVE while Connecting, then the active icon when Connected.

cases.title: A tile tap before the service binds is replayed
preconditions: The tile panel was just opened and the service connection is not bound yet.
steps: Tap the tile before onServiceConnected arrives.
Wait for the connection.
expected: The tap sets tapPending and does nothing yet.
When onServiceConnected runs, the tap is replayed and the service toggles.

cases.title: A tile tap on a locked device unlocks first
preconditions: The device is locked.
Allow Toggling in Lock Screen is off.
steps: Tap the tile.
Complete or cancel the unlock prompt.
expected: unlockAndRun shows the unlock prompt.
After a successful unlock the service toggles; a cancelled unlock changes nothing.

cases.title: The Toggle shortcut stops a running service
preconditions: The service is Connected.
The Toggle shortcut is available from the launcher.
steps: Long press the app icon and tap Toggle.
Return to the app.
expected: QuickToggleShortcut binds to the service, calls Core.stopService and finishes.
The main screen shows the service stopped.

cases.title: A shortcut creation request returns the Toggle shortcut
preconditions: A launcher sends ACTION_CREATE_SHORTCUT to QuickToggleShortcut.
steps: Send the create-shortcut intent.
expected: The activity returns RESULT_OK with shortcut id toggle, the label Toggle and the app icon, then finishes without toggling.

cases.title: The Scan QR code shortcut opens the scanner
preconditions: The static shortcuts are available from the launcher.
steps: Long press the app icon and tap Scan QR code.
expected: ScannerActivity opens and requests the camera if the permission is not granted.

cases.title: Auto Connect starts the service after boot
preconditions: Auto Connect is off, a valid profile is selected, and the service has not started since install.
steps: Turn Auto Connect on in global settings.
Reboot the device and let it send BOOT_COMPLETED.
Wait for the service to start.
expected: BootReceiver.enabled is false before the switch is turned on and becomes true when it is.
The enabled receiver receives the broadcast.
Core.startService starts the service with the saved profile, and the notification shows the profile name.

cases.title: A boot broadcast with Auto Connect off does not start the service
preconditions: The Auto Connect preference reads off while the BootReceiver component is still enabled, for example after settings were restored.
A boot broadcast reaches the receiver.
steps: Send BOOT_COMPLETED.
Read the receiver component state and the service state.
expected: BootReceiver disables itself and returns.
No service starts, no notification is posted, and later boots do not reach the receiver.

cases.title: Selecting a Tasker profile row returns the setting
preconditions: Tasker opens ConfigActivity with EDIT_SETTING.
Three active profiles exist, including Tokyo and Berlin.
The saved setting selects Tokyo.
steps: Tap Use the current profile.
Open the editor again with EDIT_SETTING and tap the Tokyo row.
Open the editor again and tap the Berlin row.
Open the editor again and tap the toolbar close icon.
expected: The first tap stores switch_on and profile_id -1, returns RESULT_OK and finishes the editor.
The Tokyo tap stores switch_on and Tokyo's id, returns RESULT_OK and finishes the editor.
The Berlin tap stores switch_on and Berlin's id, returns RESULT_OK and finishes the editor.
The close tap returns no result, and the last saved setting stays.

cases.title: A fired Tasker setting switches profile and restarts the service
preconditions: A Tasker action stores switch_on true and the Tokyo profile id.
The service is running on another profile.
steps: Fire the action with FIRE_SETTING.
Observe the service.
expected: Core.switchProfile selects Tokyo.
Core.startService runs, then Core.reloadService restarts the running service on Tokyo.

cases.title: A fired Tasker setting with the switch off stops the service
preconditions: A Tasker action stores switch_on false and a valid profile id.
The service is Connected.
steps: Fire the action with FIRE_SETTING.
Observe the service and the boot receiver.
expected: Core.switchProfile still selects the stored profile.
Core.stopService stops the service, and the normal stop disables the boot receiver.

cases.title: Each service mode has its own notification channel
preconditions: The device runs Android 8.0 (API 26) or later.
steps: Launch the app and read the notification channels it created.
Start the service in VPN mode and read the notification channel.
Repeat in proxy and transproxy mode.
expected: The channels service-vpn, service-proxy and service-transproxy exist with the names VPN Service, Proxy Service and Transproxy Service.
The VPN notification is posted on service-vpn, and that channel has IMPORTANCE_MIN on API 28+ and IMPORTANCE_LOW on API 26 and 27.
The proxy and transproxy notifications are posted on their channels, which use IMPORTANCE_LOW.

cases.title: The tile service requires the tile permission and runs direct boot aware
preconditions: The device runs Android 7.0 (API 24) or later.
steps: Read the TileService component and its metadata.
Open Quick Settings while the device is locked after a direct boot.
expected: The service is exported, declares android:permission BIND_QUICK_SETTINGS_TILE, and is a directBootAware toggleable tile with the TOGGLEABLE_TILE metadata.
Only the system UI can bind the service; another app without the permission cannot.
The tile is reachable while the device is locked after a direct boot.

cases.title: A tile long press opens the main screen
preconditions: The Toggle tile is in Quick Settings.
steps: Long-press the tile.
expected: The system launches MainActivity through the QS_TILE_PREFERENCES intent filter.
MainActivity shows the main screen with the profile list because it has no tile-preference handling.

cases.title: The launcher menu offers the two static shortcuts
preconditions: The launcher shows the app's static shortcuts.
steps: Long-press the app icon.
expected: The menu lists Toggle and Scan QR code from shortcuts.xml, declared through the android.app.shortcuts metadata.
Toggle starts QuickToggleShortcut with ACTION_MAIN and Scan QR code starts ScannerActivity.

cases.title: A locked device starts the service from the device-protected profile
preconditions: The device runs API 24+ with per-user encryption and Allow Toggling in Lock Screen is on.
A profile named Tokyo is selected and copied to device-protected storage.
Auto Connect is on and the device rebooted into the locked state.
steps: Let LOCKED_BOOT_COMPLETED start the service while the device stays locked.
Read the profile used for the start and the notification.
expected: DataStore.directBootAware is true, so Core.currentProfile returns DirectBoot.getDeviceProfile without the credential-encrypted database.
The service starts with the Tokyo profile from the device copy.
The notification content title shows Tokyo.

cases.title: Shutdown counters survive in the device profile and flush after unlock
preconditions: Direct boot is on and the device profile copy exists.
The service is running while the device is locked.
steps: Send ACTION_SHUTDOWN.
Reboot and unlock the device.
expected: The close receiver calls persistStats; the credential-encrypted database is unreachable, so the counters go into the device profile, the profile gets the dirty flag and DirectBoot.listenForUnlock registers for ACTION_BOOT_COMPLETED.
After unlock, the ACTION_BOOT_COMPLETED receiver that listenForUnlock registered calls DirectBoot.flushTrafficStats; if the process starts after the unlock instead, Core.init runs the same flush.
The database profile gets the counters and the device copy is refreshed.

cases.title: Screen events during Connecting do not change the traffic subscription
preconditions: The VPN service is Connecting to a server that takes a few seconds to answer.
The screen is on when the service starts.
steps: Turn the screen off before the state becomes Connected.
Let the service connect and send traffic.
Stop the service, turn the screen off, start it again, and turn the screen on before the state becomes Connected.
expected: ServiceNotification.onReceive ignores the screen-off because the state is not Connected, so the callback stays registered.
The notification shows live rates although the screen is off.
The start with the screen off registers no callback, and the screen-on while Connecting is ignored, so the notification shows no rates for that session.

cases.title: Each boot action starts only in its own direct boot mode
preconditions: Auto Connect is on and BootReceiver.enabled is true.
A valid profile named Tokyo is selected.
The device runs API 24 or later with per-user encryption.
steps: Turn Allow Toggling in Lock Screen off. Send BOOT_COMPLETED.
Stop the service. Send LOCKED_BOOT_COMPLETED with direct boot still off.
Turn Allow Toggling in Lock Screen on. Reboot into the locked state. Let LOCKED_BOOT_COMPLETED arrive.
Unlock the device. Let BOOT_COMPLETED arrive.
Stop the service. Send MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED while the user is unlocked.
expected: The receiver starts the service. The notification content title shows Tokyo.
No service starts. No notification is posted. DataStore.directBootAware is false, so LOCKED_BOOT_COMPLETED does not start the service.
The receiver starts the service from the device-protected profile. The notification content title shows Tokyo.
The receiver does not start the service again on BOOT_COMPLETED. Direct boot is on, so the service stays as it is.
The receiver starts the service. Direct boot is on and the user is unlocked.

cases.title: The Tasker editor lists the current profile first, then the active profiles
preconditions: Tasker opens ConfigActivity with EDIT_SETTING.
Tokyo and Berlin are active profiles, in that user order.
An obsolete profile named Paris exists.
steps: Read the profile list.
Delete the Tokyo and Berlin profiles. Open the editor again.
expected: Position 0 is Use the current profile. Position 1 is Tokyo. Position 2 is Berlin. Paris is absent.
The list shows only Use the current profile at position 0.

notes: All listed files exist. shortcuts.xml is listed in both U10 and U11 by the unit map; this unit covers its two shortcut entries. The Auto Connect and Allow Toggling in Lock Screen switches live in U09 (pref_global.xml); U11 records their effects on BootReceiver and DirectBoot but does not duplicate their controls. toolbar_light_dark.xml is included from the plugin module; its title TextView and navigation button have no ids of their own. The boot and direct-boot cases have no in-app control, so their control_path anchors on the notification that the started service posts, or on that notification staying absent when no service starts. The Tasker-fire cases anchor on the Tasker action blurb. HarmonyOS parity: the VPN-mode notification exists (ConnectionNotification.ets) with the app name as the title, the profile name in the content text, rates every 2 s and a Disconnect action; it has no content intent, no totals and no screen-off pause. The proxy mode relies on the system continuous-task notification (ProxyService.ets), not an app notification. Quick Settings tile, launcher shortcuts, boot auto-connect, direct boot storage and Tasker are absent; the parity reference lists the Android tile, shortcuts, boot receiver and Tasker as Android-only surfaces.
